_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking up the Haulest cost range

description: Returns Haulest's research planning range (low and high, with currency) for a household move in the United States, Canada, or the United Kingdom, from home size and distance. Pass a distance band, a mileage, or an origin and destination; the tool resolves the distance from stored route data where it can. The range is compiled from published industry tables and public quotes, not a bid from a mover. Use it when someone asks what a move might cost.

distanceBand.description: Distance band when known: local (under 50 mi; UK under 20), regional, mid, long, cross-country.

from.description: Origin city or town, or a ZIP or postcode, e.g. "Austin, TX", "78701", or "London".

homeSize.description: Home size: studio, 1bed, 2bed, 3bed, or 4bed (4bed covers larger homes).

market.description: Country: us, ca, or uk. Inferred from the places when omitted; defaults to us.

miles.description: Driving distance in miles when the user already knows it.

to.description: Destination city or town, or a ZIP or postcode.

name: estimate_moving_cost
title: Estimate moving cost
